'''Niordi''' were a [[Near-Human]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Niorde]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. [[D'harhan]] was a Niordi.
